This is documentation authoring platform for Axtroid Documentation Portal ↗.

The technical information on Axtroid products in terms Quick Start, User Manuals, Service Manuals, FAQs, etc. are available through the Axtroid Documentation Portal ↗.

Any changes triggered can be edited and made live.

Prerequisites

Always make sure you have necessary access to work on DocStudio.

NoteBefore you start using DocStudio, download the stand-alone application. Contact admin.
  1. Once the application is downloaded, click to open it.
  2. Make sure you see instructions page.
  3. Follow the instructions to set the real-time authoring-environment.
  4. Click ⚙️icon on the top left, to edit GitHub Settings.
  5. Fill the details as shown below then click Connect.
    1. Owner: axtroid
    2. Repo: documentation
    3. Path: docs/index.html (obtain it from your admin)
    4. Branch: main
    5. Personal access token: (obtain it from you admin)
ImportantRefresh (F5 or Ctrl+R) to load the latest content from the server.
